description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Discernis builds AI-powered legal discovery software for litigation teams handling large collections of documents and communications. The Software Engineer will build and ship product features across frontend UX, backend services, DevOps, and AI integrations for attorneys’ workflows.
Software Engineer building attorney workflow software through frontend UX, platform engineering, and AI integration

Responsibilities:
• You'll be one of a handful of engineers building the product attorneys use every day
• The work is broad: frontend and workflow UX, backend services, DevOps, and integrating our AI into real workflows
• We care a lot about the frontend, because the best retrieval in the world doesn't matter if the attorney's experience is clunky

Requirements:
• 0 to 3 years of experience and a strong CS foundation
• You ship
• You'd rather close five tickets well than plan one forever
• You design the solution first, then use AI tools to move faster, not to think for you
• You pick up new stacks on your own and take ownership without being asked
• When you apply, please include one link to something you've built

Preferred:
• A degree from a top CS program, or experience at FAANG or a high-growth startup
• Frontend depth: you care how software feels to use
• Projects that integrate LLMs into real workflows
